notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Derevi enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Derevi.
Repeat.
